scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:web
scripts.build: pnpm run story:compile -- --strict && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:web
scripts.typecheck:packages: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b apps/server packages/story-schema packages/game-runtime packages/api-contract
scripts.e2e: echo "Playwright e2e 由独立 worker 实例驱动；当前先运行 pnpm test 作为最小验收。" && pnpm test
